product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides cloud-based practice management software for dental practices, combining clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments, and patient engagement in one platform.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists, with personalized quotes.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 215 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents product information and dental-practice advice, rather than engineer-authored explanations of how Curve is built.

public_docs.notes: The public help center includes a multi-article Quick Guides collection, FAQs, videos, and release information.

model_provider.notes: Curve publicly describes its Pearl AI integration for dental-radiograph analysis and AI second opinions; this identifies an integrated AI provider, not a foundation-model backend.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 claims apply to its data center. HIPAA is described as adherence to privacy regulations, not a separate certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn lists one Series A round from Battery Ventures on February 8, 2018, with an undisclosed amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly listed funding round was in February 2018, before the requested 18-month window.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve introduced Curve Memberships on September 3, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Curve announced Rick Hansen's appointment as Chief Customer Officer on September 29, 2026; he joined after holding senior customer-leadership roles at Weave.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Customer Account Executive posting requires using Salesforce and Gong to maintain prospect data and track sales opportunities and activities.
